newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - Mapfre Vida rated "buy".
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Mapfre Vida rated "buy".

text.p: Stockbroker Salomon Brothers said on Wednesday it had reinstated Spain's Mapfre Vida to its buy list.
"A 17 percent underperformance, together with a positive reassessment of the valuation permits us to reinstate the stock as a buy," Salomon said in a note.
Positive factors include a rebound in premium growth so far in 1997 and the prospect of pension reform supporting future growth.
Salomon said it has reduced its 1997 and 1998 earnings forecasts for the life insurer, but still expects robust net earnings growth.
The broker has also increased its embedded value estimate by 18 percent to 4,206 pesetas per share as at end 1996 after detailed discussions with company management.
Salomon said it has raised its price target for Mapfre Vida to 10,200 pesetas. The shares are currently trading around 8,860.
